independent_decimal_recomputations.case: September15 operative newly usable commercial parcel
independent_decimal_recomputations.legal_decision: s2001(f) expressly counts each month or fraction; operative assessment date is assumed, not derived from completion. Nonexempt improved not under-improved and public-land exclusion retained.

independent_decimal_recomputations.case: Whole owner primary home versus whole house let for private profit
independent_decimal_recomputations.legal_decision: s2000(d)(11) requires natural-person owner wholly occupying primary home and excludes whole/part letting for profit; letting expressly in d(2) and c(1) rate. Each scenario whole year, no income-tax inference.

additional_boundary_read: Jan31 full tax vs Feb1 proration and five-year start; June15 ordinary determination+notice rules read and kept separate.
